title: A New Game Begins
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was deploying his strategy, the fifth page of the Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light—the ancient characters seemed to come alive, constantly reorganizing themselves in the void. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul showed astonishment for the first time: 'It... it's actually responding to your sister's existence. This is impossible, unless...'

text.content:
Ling Yuan's disheveled retreating figure seared like a brand, deeply embedded in Chen Ji's heart. Beneath the moonlight, he stood alone on the massive stone of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, his robes fluttering violently in the night wind. Those words about the Great Zhou Dragon Court and Chen Tianming had become an invisible blade, gouging at the softest corner of his heart with each strike.

He slowly closed his eyes, letting memories surge like a tide—the father he never met, the legendary ancestor who could speak with the heavens, the secret that generations of the Chen family had guarded with their lives.

'The Great Zhou Dragon Court...' Chen Ji murmured, a complex light flickering in his eyes.

He was no stranger to the Dragon Court's existence. Quite the opposite—for this chess game today, he had secretly investigated for three full years. The Dragon Court,号称大周皇朝历代天子陨落后灵魂归处, was an existence beyond all sects—even the three supreme sects had to kowtow to its authority.

dialogue.content:
'Father, what exactly did you leave me?' Chen Ji whispered, his voice torn to shreds by the mountain wind. 'And... the Chen Tianming that Ling Yuan mentioned, who is he?'

He opened his eyes, the confusion in his gaze replaced by determination. No matter how many thorns lay ahead, he had to press forward. For revenge, for the truth, and most importantly, for his sister who had been missing for years with no news whatsoever.

text.content:
A haunting fragrance drifted over, like a Manjusaka blooming in the dead of night—bewitching and dangerous. Chen Ji's expression remained utterly calm, as if he had long anticipated this visitor's arrival. He still stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze fixed on the distant mountain silhouettes in the night.

'The Holy Sect's Saintess of the Demonic Path, visiting my Tianqing Sect Back Mountain in the dead of night—are you not afraid I would raise the alarm and summon the entire mountain's guards?' His tone was placid as water, betraying not a hint of anger or fear.

dialogue.content:
'If you wanted to raise the alarm, you would have done so long ago. Why wait until now?' Ye Qing's voice was like ice water striking stone, cold and clear with a hint of playfulness. 'Besides, with Chen Gongzi's capabilities, even if I summoned the entire mountain's guards, I doubt they could keep you here, no?'

She stepped forward slowly, standing shoulder to shoulder with Chen Ji, her gaze also directed toward the distant night sky. Moonlight fell upon her profile, outlining a coldly beautiful face—the kind of visage that could topple countless cultivators.

text.content:
'The Saintess is rather frank.' Chen Ji glanced at her, the corner of his mouth slightly raised. 'Since that's the case, I won't hold back either. Saintess Ye, visiting in the dead of night—I presume this isn't a moonlight appreciation call?'

Ye Qing turned to face Chen Ji directly, the playfulness in her eyes fading, replaced by a rare gravity: 'I need an ally.'

choice.prompt: Ye Qing came straight to the point about forming an alliance, and Chen Ji must decide how to respond—this is a crucial choice concerning future strategic布局.

choices.description: No need to reveal one's stance prematurely—listen to what Ye Qing can offer as leverage, then decide the depth of cooperation.
choices.risk_hint: May Let the Other Party Gauge One's Bottom Line

dialogue.content: A flash of appreciation appeared in Ye Qing's eyes: 'Refreshingly direct. I need you to help me break the Holy Sect's forbidden seal.' Her voice lowered slightly. 'In exchange, I can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record for you, so no one can deduce your whereabouts.'

choices.description: People of the Demonic Path cannot be trusted—rashly forming an alliance may bring disaster; better maintain distance.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's smile froze on her face, then transformed into a light laugh: 'Chen Gongzi is indeed cautious. But do you think refusing me means you can stand apart from all this?' Her tone suddenly turned cold. 'I have already sensed the aura of the Tianji Record. Throughout this world, how many countless people covet it?'

choices.description: Demonstrate some of the Tianji Record's abilities, in exchange for Ye Qing showing her sincerity first and proving her worth.
choices.risk_hint: May expose the limitations of the Tianji Record

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji did not speak, merely raising his hand as the Tianji Record Fragment manifested a faint golden light in his palm. He softly stated what would happen an hour later, logically ordered and precisely detailed.

Ye Qing's face changed abruptly, his gaze toward Chen Ji surging with great waves: "You... this is a true Heavenly Secrets Prophecy?"

text.content:
Night wind rose suddenly, swirling countless falling leaves. At that moment, a familiar aura approached from the distant Mountain Path—a bone-deep sense of blood connection, an unbreakable familial bond no disguise could conceal.

Chen Ji's form froze instantly.

dialogue.content:
"Brother..."

That voice was gentle and familiar, like the little girl who always used to follow behind him in his memories. Chen Ji turned sharply, his pupils contracting—under the moonlight, a young woman in plain clothes stood not far away, graceful and elegant, with bright eyes and white teeth, her features remarkably similar to his own.

It was Chen Nian. His sister who had been missing for years.

text.content:
Chen Ji's breath turned suddenly ragged. His hands trembled slightly—the face he had seen countless times in dreams now appeared truly before him. Three years,整整 three years of searching across countless mountains and rivers, and his sister had actually appeared before him like this.

However, years of restraint allowed him to quickly suppress the excitement in his heart, his gaze becoming even deeper: "Nian'er... why are you here?"

choice.prompt: Reunited as siblings, Chen Ji needed to remain clear-headed amid overwhelming emotions—why was Chen Nian here? Was she safe? This concerned the arrangements to follow.

choices.description: Suppress emotions and first clarify how Chen Nian escaped from the Holy Sect, whether she was followed.
choices.risk_hint: The sister may misunderstand the brother's concern

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's eyes reddened slightly, yet she did not shed tears. She gently shook her head: "Don't worry, Brother. The people of the Holy Sect don't know I'm here. It was that Mo Xiansheng who guided me to find you." Her voice trembled slightly, "These three years, I've thought of you every moment..."

choices.description: Three years of searching finally yielded results—forget about reason for this moment!
choices.visible_cost: May expose weakness before Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: As a strategist, one should not lose composure before an enemy

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji could no longer hold back, striding forward to embrace his sister. His voice turned hoarse: "It's alright now... Brother is here, from now on no one can hurt you again."

Chen Nian lay against his shoulder, tears finally streaming down. The fear, loneliness, and longing of three years transformed entirely into scalding hot tears at this moment.

choices.description: Why would Mo Xiansheng guide Chen Nian here? Does this hold some deeper meaning?
choices.risk_hint: May make the sister feel estranged

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's gaze slightly froze: "Mo Xiansheng guided you here?" His brow furrowed tightly, "Did he say anything else?"

Chen Nian wiped her tears, retrieving an ancient jade pendant from her chest: "He said... to have you give this to the Tianji Record."

text.content:
Chen Ji took the jade pendant, seeing upon it an ancient rune surprisingly similar to the patterns on the Tianji Record Fragment. As he pressed the jade pendant close to the Tianji Record—

Blinding golden light burst forth from the fragment, illuminating the entire night sky!

The outline of the fifth page of the Tianji Record slowly emerged. Where there had been a blur of emptiness, an ancient line of text was now gradually revealing itself—

"Heavenly Fate Lock Key, Apex of the Imperial Court."

Eight large characters, as if written personally by the Heavenly Dao, each one radiating a terrifying pressure.

dialogue.content:
Just then, a ethereal voice sounded in Chen Ji's mind—it was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul.

"The fifth page... actually manifested at this time." There was a rare hint of excitement in Mo Xiansheng's voice. "Heavenly Fate Lock Key, Apex of the Imperial Court... So that's how it is, so that's how it is! Young master, what your father left you isn't just the Tianji Record, but the lifeblood of the entire Great Zhou Dragon Court!"

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart rate abruptly quickened. The lifeblood of the Great Zhou Dragon Court? What exactly was his father's identity? What connection did that Chen Tianming have to the Dragon Court?

He took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Whatever the truth might be, the most urgent matter now was to consolidate the resources at hand, preparing for the coming storm.

He turned to look at Ye Qing and Chen Nian, his eyes gleaming with sharp light. The Holy Sect's Saint Maiden, the remnant soul guardian, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key—three beings with no connection whatsoever, now bound together by him, by the Tianji Record, their threads of destiny intertwined.

"What we're about to do next might shake the entire cultivation world to its foundations." His voice was low but resolute. "Are you willing to enter this game with me?"

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing spoke first, her eyes blazing with fervor: "I was already a player in this game. Cooperating with you might give me a chance at survival. Struggling alone would only make me fish on the Holy Sect's chopping block."

She paused, a cold, enchanting smile curling at her lips: "Besides, I'm always interested in anything that makes the Holy Sect eat humble pie."

Chen Nian gently tugged at her brother's sleeve, her voice soft: "Brother, Nian is not afraid. Three years, I've finally found you. Whatever you do, Nian will be by your side."

Her gaze was gentle yet resolute: "And... Nian might be able to help. Those Holy Sect people kept calling me a 'Lock Key.' I don't know the specifics, but I can vaguely sense certain things."

choice.prompt: The strategic alliance was officially established. Chen Ji needed to decide the primary course of action—whether to gather intelligence on the Dragon Court or consolidate existing strength first?

choices.description: Immediately begin collecting intelligence on the Great Zhou Dragon Court, preparing to seize the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.'

text.content:
Chen Ji said in a deep voice: "Since the Tianji Record points to the apex of the imperial court, we'll start from the court. Holy Maiden, having been in the Demonic Path for years, do you know of any hidden connections the Dragon Court has?"

Ye Qing contemplated briefly: "The Dragon Court operates in secret, but every generation of Heavenly Son leaves bloodline descendants in the mortal world. If we can find those descendants, perhaps we can pry open a gap."

choices.description: First integrate existing resources, consolidate our foundation within the Tianqing Sect, ensuring the home front doesn't catch fire.
choices.risk_hint: May allow enemies to seize the initiative

text.content:
Chen Ji nodded slightly: "No rush. The Dragon Court has been dormant for a thousand years—it can't be toppled in a day or two. The priority now is to stabilize our roots."

He looked at Ye Qing: "If the Holy Maiden wishes to stay near the Tianqing Sect, she'll need a plausible identity. I can arrange it."

Ye Qing laughed lightly: "Young Master Chen is quite thorough."

choices.description: Ling Yuan knows too many secrets. We must quickly clarify his relationship with Chen Tianming and the Great Zhou Dragon Court.

dialogue.content:
A cold glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes: "This Ling Yuan cannot be left unchecked. He knows about Chen Tianming and mentioned the Dragon Court—his intentions are despicable."

Chen Nian's expression subtly changed upon hearing this: "Brother, Ling Yuan... When I was at the Holy Sect, I heard them mention this name. They called him the Tianqing Sect's 'old遗珠,' seemingly related to some ancient secret."

text.content:
Night deepens, and the mountain wind howls. Chen Ji stands atop the boulder, his robes fluttering violently in the wind, eyes blazing like torches. Behind him, Ye Qing and Chen Nian flank him on left and right, like two unsheathed gleaming swords.

At this moment, the bearer of the Tianji Record is finally no longer alone. One is a废物 disciple who roamed the world bearing the name of "waste;" one is a rebellious saint from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path; one is a mysterious girl destined by fate—three souls abandoned by destiny have finally come together in this magnificent era of sweeping currents.

The golden radiance of the fifth page of the Tianji Record gradually fades, yet those eight characters are seared into Chen Ji's heart like a brand—'Heaven's Mandate Lock-Key, Apex of the Imperial Dynasty.' These mere eight words have unveiled a shocking grand scheme buried for a millennium.

And he, Chen Ji, this once-ridiculed废物 who was laughed at by all, shall personally take up the pieces and play this game, stirring up the winds and clouds of this world!

A new round of the game has officially begun.
